questions.question:
Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence.
He said that he [finish] the report by Friday.
A) would finish
B) had finished
C) was finishing
D) finishes

Select the correct reported speech form.
She said, 'I have just seen Tom.'
A) She said she had just seen Tom.
B) She said she was just seeing Tom.
C) She said she would have just seen Tom.
D) She said she has just seen Tom.
options: She said she had just seen Tom.
She said she was just seeing Tom.
She said she would have just seen Tom.
She said she has just seen Tom.
questions.answer: She said she had just seen Tom.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly reports the following direct speech?
He said, 'If I were you, I would accept the job.'
A) He said that if he was you, he would accept the job.
B) He said that if he were you, he would accept the job.
C) He said that if he had been you, he would accept the job.
D) He said that if he had been you, he would have accepted the job.
options: He said that if he was you, he would accept the job.
He said that if he were you, he would accept the job.
He said that if he had been you, he would accept the job.
He said that if he had been you, he would have accepted the job.
questions.answer: He said that if he were you, he would accept the job.

questions.question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
By the time we arrived, the concert _____.
A) had already started
B) already had started
C) has already started
D) already starts

Select the correct conditional type for the sentence.
If I knew his phone number, I would call him.
A) First conditional
B) Second conditional
C) Third conditional
D) Zero conditional

Which of the following is the correct reported form?
He said, 'I am looking for a new apartment.'
A) He said that he is looking for a new apartment.
B) He said that he was looking for a new apartment.
C) He said that he had been looking for a new apartment.
D) He said that he has been looking for a new apartment.
options: He said that he is looking for a new apartment.
He said that he was looking for a new apartment.
He said that he had been looking for a new apartment.
He said that he has been looking for a new apartment.
questions.answer: He said that he was looking for a new apartment.

questions.question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.
If only I _____ so stupid! I ruined the whole project.
A) weren't
B) wasn't
C) had been
D) was not

Select the correct option to complete the sentence.
I wish I _____ more time to finish my homework.
A) had
B) had had
C) have
D) would have

Which of the following sentences correctly uses the passive voice?
A) The report was being written by John.
B) The report was wrote by John.
C) The report was written by John.
D) The report was being wrote by John.
options: The report was being written by John.
The report was wrote by John.
The report was written by John.
The report was being wrote by John.
questions.answer: The report was written by John.
